name: +1 Wings for Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to +1 Wings for Brainrots 🦅

Fly higher, go farther, and collect as many Brainrots as you can! Use your growing flight speed to reach insane heights and discover new areas! 🌌

How to play:
🕊️ Fly your way across each area
🧠 Collect Brainrots to earn Cash
⚡ Gain +1 Flight speed every time you progress
💵 Upgrade your Brainrots to boost your income
🏗️ Expand your base to unlock more storage slots

💤 Your Brainrots generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

Rebirth to multiply your cash! ♻️

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE Brainrot!
